text:
[LTHE.2.5.1] By default, a sequence pattern follows Rete's
all-matches semantics: if two `DoorOpen` events
both fall within the window before `Motion`, the
rule fires twice (one activation per valid pair).
This matches how the rest of DS handles
multi-match patterns and composes with refraction.
